INCIDENT REPORT - filed 23 October, 08:05

At about 22:30 last night an office laptop was taken from a staff vehicle parked outside the field office. The laptop holds the regional contact database, including personal phone numbers of partner-agency staff. The disk is encrypted but the device was in sleep mode, not shut down.
Police report filed (ref. CPD-88213). We have not yet revoked the device's VPN certificate. Requesting the security desk's instructions this morning.
